narration.en: Look at a leaf peel under a microscope and you see tiny mouths, each guarded by two bean-shaped cells. They decide when the leaf breathes and loses water.
narration.kn: ಎಲೆಯ ಸಿಪ್ಪೆಯನ್ನು ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ ನೋಡಿದರೆ ಎರಡು ಅವರೆಕಾಳಿನಾಕಾರದ ಕೋಶಗಳು ಕಾಯುವ ಸಣ್ಣ ಬಾಯಿಗಳು ಕಾಣುತ್ತವೆ. ಅವು ಎಲೆಯ ಉಸಿರಾಟ ಮತ್ತು ನೀರಿನ ನಷ್ಟವನ್ನು ನಿರ್ಧರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: The epidermis is the outermost layer of the plant body, made of elongated, compactly arranged cells. It is often covered by a waxy cuticle that prevents water loss; the cuticle is absent in roots. Stomata regulate transpiration and gas exchange. Each stoma has two bean-shaped guard cells with chloroplasts, which are dumb-bell shaped in grasses. The stomatal aperture, guard cells and the surrounding subsidiary cells together form the stomatal apparatus. Root hairs are unicellular outgrowths of root epidermal cells, while trichomes on the stem are usually multicellular and help prevent water loss.
body.kn: ಹೊರಚರ್ಮ ಸಸ್ಯದ ಹೊರಪದರ; ಕ್ಯೂಟಿಕಲ್ ನೀರಿನ ನಷ್ಟ ತಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಪತ್ರರಂಧ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಎರಡು ಅವರೆಕಾಳಿನಾಕಾರದ ಕಾವಲು ಕೋಶಗಳು; ಹುಲ್ಲುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಡಂಬೆಲ್ ಆಕಾರ. ರಂಧ್ರ, ಕಾವಲು ಕೋಶ ಮತ್ತು ಉಪಕೋಶಗಳು ಸೇರಿ ಪತ್ರರಂಧ್ರ ಸಾಧನ.

points.en: Guard cells: bean-shaped; dumb-bell in grasses
Stomatal apparatus = aperture + guard cells + subsidiary cells

title.en: On the board: The tissue systems

say.en: A plant body has three tissue systems. Look at a stem section.
The epidermal system is the outer layer, often with a cuticle.
The vascular system is the xylem and phloem in bundles.
Everything else, cortex, pericycle and pith, is the ground tissue system.
Stomata: two bean-shaped guard cells around a pore; in grasses they are dumb-bell shaped.
Vascular bundles: open with cambium in dicot stems, closed without it in monocots, radial in roots.

body.en: All tissues except the epidermis and vascular bundles make up the ground tissue. It consists of simple tissues: parenchyma, collenchyma and sclerenchyma, found in the cortex, pericycle, pith and medullary rays of stems and roots. In leaves, the ground tissue is the thin-walled, chloroplast-containing mesophyll.
body.kn: ಹೊರಚರ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ನಾಳಪುಂಜಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಉಳಿದ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಅಂಗಾಂಶಗಳು ಆಧಾರ ಅಂಗಾಂಶ ವ್ಯೂಹ: ತೊಗಟೆ, ಪರಿಚಕ್ರ, ಮಜ್ಜೆ, ಮೆಡ್ಯುಲರಿ ಕಿರಣಗಳು. ಎಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೀಸೋಫಿಲ್.

body.en: Xylem and phloem together form vascular bundles. In dicot stems, cambium between xylem and phloem allows secondary growth, so the bundles are open; monocot bundles have no cambium and are closed. When xylem and phloem lie on different radii alternately, as in roots, the bundle is radial. When they lie together on the same radius, as in stems and leaves, it is conjoint, with phloem usually on the outer side of the xylem.
body.kn: ದಾರು ಮತ್ತು ಅನ್ನನಾಳ ಸೇರಿ ನಾಳಪುಂಜ. ಕ್ಯಾಂಬಿಯಂ ಇದ್ದರೆ ತೆರೆದ (ದ್ವಿದಳ ಕಾಂಡ), ಇಲ್ಲದಿದ್ದರೆ ಮುಚ್ಚಿದ (ಏಕದಳ). ಬೇರುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ತ್ರಿಜ್ಯೀಯ, ಕಾಂಡ ಮತ್ತು ಎಲೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ನಾಳಪುಂಜ.
